title: San Diego Chinese Food Tour with Wild Foodie Tours
includes: A traditional Chinese meal of your choice with tea.
Resources in San Diego to learn more about Chinese culture.
Insight into Chinese history and culture.
A Chinese-American tour guide who specializes in Chinese cuisine.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Don't miss this exciting foodie adventure with Wild Foodie Tours to learn about and enjoy Chinese food, history, and culture from a Chinese-American guide whose passion is food, culture, and adventure.

Prepare to enter the Dragon's Gate to savor the culinary masterpiece once reserved for the Emperor of China.
